_doc: The freighter Tin Duchess, the opening slice's ship (launch map lane, 2026-11-16). One walkable map per room, doors between them. `beats`: where each scene beat happens (scene numbers from the quest lane's STORY-NOW.md), checked by tests/stardust-duchess.test.mjs. `flags`: the save flags the rooms listen to (the quest lane sets them in scene rewards; a script can also force a state with world.setState). Story text lives in the quests, not here.
name: The Tin Duchess

flags.s1-valve-fixed: Scene 1, hands-on: the foam valve was tightened in the water game, so the pipe runs intact and the foam stops.
flags.s1-hose-fixed: Scene 1, hands-on: the coolant hose was patched, so the slick under it dries.
flags.s1-mess: Scene 1, hands-on: a lost valve or hose floods the room, so more goo lies on the floor to mop (cleared by s1-mopped).
flags.s1-mopped: Scene 1, hands-on: the floor was mopped clean in the mop game, so every goo patch is gone.
flags.s1-mop-held: Scene 1, hands-on: a mop is in the player's hand (with s1-mop-cart it came from the cart, else the leaning one is gone).
flags.s1-mop-cart: Scene 1, hands-on: the mop was taken from the supply cart, so the one leaning by the cart is still there.
flags.goo-cleared: Scene 1 ends with a clean floor (end-clean or end-source-fixed): the holodeck goo is gone.
flags.goo-source-fixed: Scene 1, the foam valve is fixed or the program reset (end-source-fixed): the valve stops leaking.
flags.holo-projector-fried: Scene 1, the projector fried (end-projector-fried): the pylons go dark, scorch on the grid.
flags.reavers-docked: Scene 2: the Reavers clamp on; the boarding clamp shows outside the airlock.
flags.reavers-boarded: Scene 2: they cut in; the outer airlock door is breached, the clamp torn open, scorch on the floor.
flags.reck-down: Scene 2: Reck is killed at the gunner seat; the seat is shot up, his body and rifle are on the bridge.
flags.reck-rifle-taken: Scene 3: you took Reck's rifle; the pickup is gone.
flags.airlock-sealed: Scene 3 side option: you hacked the inner airlock door shut; it shows locked.
flags.reavers-repelled: Scene 3 won: two Reavers lie in the corridor, the gunner rack is empty.
flags.turret-repaired: Scene 5 turret job: the gunner seat is whole again.
flags.nessa-quit: Scene 5: Nessa has quit; she is gone from the ship.
flags.pip-quit: Scene 5: Pip has quit; he is gone from the ship.
flags.duchess-busted: Scene 6, day 5: the ship is the busted wreck you are handed (dead reactor, broken console, leaks, blown hull plate, open conduit).
flags.reactor-fixed: Repair job: the reactor runs again and the engine console comes back on.
flags.power-fixed: Repair job: the conduit panel is closed up.
flags.coolant-leaking: Scene 5 (days 2 to 4), set when the week's jobs begin: the engine room's coolant line sprays until coolant-fixed.
flags.coolant-fixed: Repair job: the leaking pipe is sealed.
flags.hull-patched: Repair job: the blown hull plate is welded.
flags.duchess-repaired: The busted hull outside on the pad is repaired.
flags.day-five-over: Scene 6 has ended, whichever way: the pad's door to Chibby's hangar opens (the repair yard).

The stuck foam valve (the water game)
The supply cart: mops, squeegee and bucket (the mop upgrade); a mop leans beside it
The gym console; the projector can fry (the power lever)
Nessa argues the toll at the helm
Tull in his chair
Reck in the gunner seat; he dies there
The Reavers clamp on and cut through the outer door
You take Reck's rifle
Hold the corridor between the airlock and the bridge
Stealth flank through the cargo hold
Hack the inner airlock door shut
Two Reavers down in the corridor
Tull offers the gunner job at his desk
Your bunk (and the nap)
Turret job: fix the gunner seat
Scan job at the nav console
Repair job in the engine room
Pip at his console, until he quits
Tull hands you the busted ship on the pad
The dead reactor comes back to life
Weld the blown hull plate
